comment: Watched feeds for weekly_scan.py. Every item still goes to the review queue — nothing publishes automatically. Only feeds VERIFIED WORKING are listed (several guessed RSS URLs rotted and were removed 2026-09-04; PubMed and ClinicalTrials.gov remain the primary catch-alls — journal papers reach PubMed within days, so feed loss costs little). 'filter' is a case-insensitive keyword ANY-match on title+summary.

removedFeeds2026-09-04.NIDCD news: 404 — URL rotted; NIDCD stories also appear in the NIH feed and PubMed
removedFeeds2026-09-04.JAMA Otolaryngology latest: 404 — RSS id wrong; JAMA papers reach PubMed within days
removedFeeds2026-09-04.Cochrane ENT new reviews: invalid XML returned; Cochrane reviews are indexed in PubMed
removedFeeds2026-09-04.EMA news: 404 — URL rotted; re-add with a verified URL if EMA coverage is needed

newsIntelNote: Google News RSS company-wire watch. Items carry intelligenceOnly=true: NEVER treated as evidence; publishable only as labeled 'Company-reported development' after verification. Audit fix: OTO-313 and STOPMD-3 toplines surfaced on wires months before any paper.

pages.name: NICE NG155 Tinnitus: assessment and management

pagesNote: Content-hash watch only — a change emits a 'review this page' queue item; the page is never parsed for meaning. Audit fix: guideline updates (NICE NG155-class events) previously had no detection path.
notes: Company announcements: deliberately NOT watched as feeds; they surface via the sources above or manual adds, and are always labeled company-reported by the evaluator.
Feed failures are per-feed warnings, never fatal; fix or replace URLs here.
To watch a specific university program, add its news RSS with a tinnitus filter — verify the URL works first.
